desc: Implement a Segment Tree with arrays `min_val`, `max_val`, and `lazy` to support range add operations and value-based range searches.
Initialize the Segment Tree leaves with values corresponding to their indices (rating $i$ starts at $i$).
For each contest $[L_i, R_i]$, use recursive descent on the Segment Tree to find the range $[l, r]$ of initial ratings whose current rating is within $[L_i, R_i]$.
Apply a range update of $+1$ to the Segment Tree for the range $[l, r]$.
After processing all contests, answer each query by reading the final value from the Segment Tree.
